title: 汇丰资管Beth Wong：印度是“反AI交易”，外资回流带来结构性机会
speaker: Beth Wong

segments.en: I think, you know, when everything everyone's talking about AI and a potentially crowded AI trade, India is basically like an anti-AI trade because, of course, like the exposure to AI is a little bit smaller than some of the North Asia friends that, you know, within the region.
segments.zh: 当所有人都在谈论AI和可能拥挤的AI交易时，印度基本上是一个“反AI交易”，因为其对AI的敞口比区域内一些北亚市场要小。

segments.en: But there's a lot of structural opportunities there. So I think, you know, whether it's on consumption, whether it's a favorable demographics in terms of actually very strong growth and car growth, car sales growth and two-weaters growth.
segments.zh: 但那里有很多结构性机会。无论是消费，还是有利的人口结构，比如强劲的增长、汽车销量增长和两轮车增长。

segments.en: So like, you know, the consumption, but we're actually quite, you know, positive on the financial sectors that we're actually quite positive on.
segments.zh: 所以消费方面，我们实际上对金融板块相当积极。

segments.en: And actually from a flow perspective, like foreign institutions are actually coming back to India since mid of June. So like July is the first month that we're actually seeing foreign flows coming through. And of course, foreign ownership is still at a 20-year low.
segments.zh: 从资金流角度看，外国机构自6月中旬以来实际上正在回流印度。7月是我们看到外资流入的第一个月。当然，外资持股仍处于20年低位。

segments.en: So from that perspective, light positioning not crowded allows structural opportunities. And within that, we're overweight on the customer discretionary and the financial space.
segments.zh: 从这个角度看，仓位不拥挤，提供了结构性机会。其中，我们超配可选消费和金融领域。
